name: Unlink
description: Private by default for the wallets and dapps you already use. Routes crypto traffic through Tor, one route per account.
//host_permissions: For the OFFSCREEN document's fetch + hash-verify of the tor-js worker bundle from its on-chain resolver. The worker's own fetches run at a null origin and do NOT use these. Narrow once the resolver host is pinned.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src *;
